scope: Matched operator versus dense GPU float64 evidence-evaluation timings on the same 200-pixel subhalo mock

timing_contract.synchronization: All JAX arrays in the public result and grid are synchronized before stopping each timer
timing_contract.includes: Joint source/potential solve, prior and posterior determinants, evidence normalization and returned numerical fields; complete nonlinear convergence for iteration
timing_contract.outside_fit_timer: File input, imports/device/geometry setup (reported separately), plotting and file export; input simulation/partition generation is outside all worker timings
timing_contract.warm_reuse: Fixed geometry, fixed block topology and compiled kernels are reusable; each fit resets original source/potential, rebuilds required blocks and recomputes approximate evidence
timing_contract.cold_limit: Compile-inclusive first fit also includes lazy numerical preparation; first minus warm is not pure compiler time
timing_contract.isolation: Serial independent GPU processes; persistent JAX compilation cache disabled
timing_contract.determinants: Principal-block Cholesky approximation; no full coupled determinant; original recorded partition and PCG controls retained
